resources.string: Pick any feature from the Table of Contents to start an interactive guided tour right inside the live Olive Branch screens.

Privacy & entry
Core safety tools
Support & emergency
Account & security
Settings tabs & secret entry
Tour every Settings tab: Profile & Cover disguise, Password & Trigger phrase, Privacy & Passkeys, and Permissions.
Pick Daily Digest or Fitness Tracker in Settings so the launcher icon and app name blend in on your phone.
Type your secret trigger phrase into the cover search bar, or double-tap the tiny olive icon in the cover Account screen.
Pass your 4–6 digit app PIN or Android device lock check to unlock Your Safe Space.
Home shortcuts & Quick Exit
Explore Quick Exit, the quick Camera capture button, My profile, Account activity, and update reminders.
Tap the floating Quick Exit button in the corner of any private screen to immediately return to your cover app.
Switching apps or turning off your screen locks Your Safe Space automatically.
In Settings → Privacy, adjust the idle-lock timer (and optional screen-capture protection) to fit your routine.
Safety plan
Build primary and backup safety checklists, save offline, share with trusted contacts, or request staff consultation.
Review and customize your primary plan, backup steps, and emergency grab-bag checklist seeded from onboarding.
Edits save locally right away and sync automatically when you reconnect.
Share your plan with selected accepted contacts (revoke anytime) or tap Request consultation for staff guidance.
Notes & incident records
Document notes and dated incidents with map locations, attachments, pinning, search, edit history, and trash restore.
Create a Note for general reminders or an Incident to record date, time, location, and encrypted file attachments.
Pin important records to the top, filter by Notes or Incidents, and search by keyword.
View the per-entry edit history log, share an entry with a trusted contact, or restore trashed items.
Encrypted documents, camera & OCR
Store AES-encrypted files, capture photos or video privately inside the app, extract text with OCR, and share securely.
Upload PDFs, photos, video, or audio; every file is encrypted on your device before upload.
Use the in-app camera to capture documents directly into encrypted storage without saving to your public gallery.
Run on-device OCR to extract and review text from document photos, then share selected files with accepted contacts.
Friends, messages, voice, media & calls
Add friends or 48h invites, send chat-only voice notes, share media/notes/plans/location, call, search, unsend, and check Chat Info.
Add trusted people by username search or generate a 48-hour one-time invite code or link.
Exchange encrypted text, chat-only voice messages, attachments, notes, safety plans, or live locations in direct or group chats.
Start an encrypted voice call, search messages, unsend your messages, or open Chat Info to review members and shared items.
Live location & navigation
Share real-time location with chosen contacts, browse saved places, view shared pins, and follow turn-by-turn routes.
Open the Location map to see your current position and saved places directory.
Start live-location sharing for a chosen duration with specific contacts, and add, remove, or stop sharing at any time.
Select a contact sharing with you or search a destination to start turn-by-turn route navigation.
Staff help & support chats
Open the Support menu (+) to request an organization staff advocate or escalate an existing conversation.
Open the Support menu (+) and tap Request help from staff, or request staff support from an existing conversation.
Wait while Olive Branch assigns an available staff member (you can cancel the request anytime before assignment).
Chat with assigned staff, share relevant notes or plans, and optionally add an accepted friend to the support ticket.
Emergency alert & PDF report
Open the Support menu (+) to compile an encrypted emergency PDF with GPS and notify organization administrators.
Trigger Emergency from the Support menu (+) inside Your Safe Space, or press and hold the cover olive icon for 2 seconds.
Olive Branch compiles your profile details, incident records, and current coordinates into an encrypted PDF in Documents.
When online, organization administrators receive an emergency alert with your report and live map tracking.
Hotlines & trusted contacts
Browse Canadian crisis lines, shelters, and legal clinics, save favorites, and maintain your trusted safe contacts.
Open Hotline resources to filter 24/7 crisis lines, shelters, legal aid, and counseling across Canadian provinces and cities.
Tap the heart icon to save important services, dial directly, or view directory locations on the map.
In Trusted contacts, record relationship notes, mark who is safe to stay with, and link entries to chat friends.
Account activity & security log
Inspect timestamped settings edits, cover trigger uses, PIN attempts, and capture privacy events.
Open Account activity to inspect timestamped settings edits, trigger events, PIN attempts, and privacy events.
In Settings → Privacy, enroll a Passkey Account Recovery Key so encrypted files and chats can be restored on a new device.
Use Settings → Permissions to review and grant camera, microphone, location, notification, and health permissions.
Quick Exit & auto-lock
Tap Quick exit in the bottom-right corner anytime to lock Your Safe Space and jump back to your cover app.
Private camera & header shortcuts
Use the top camera icon for private capture straight into encrypted storage, or the gear icon to open Settings.
My profile & Account activity
Check My profile details, audit Account activity logs, or jump into your tools below.
Private feature tiles
Open Notes & incidents, Messages, Safety plan, or encrypted Documents directly from this dashboard grid.
Support menu (+) · Staff help
We opened the + menu for you: tap Request help from staff to match with an advocate, cancel anytime while waiting, or add a friend later.
Support menu (+) · Emergency PDF & alert
Tap Emergency here (or long-press the cover olive for 2s) to save an encrypted GPS PDF in Documents and alert admins when online.
Support menu (+) · Map, hotlines & contacts
Open Map view, Walkthrough, Hotline resources, or Trusted contacts from the expanded + menu on any screen.
Safety plan · Primary tab
View and edit your primary safety steps; changes save locally right away and sync automatically when online.
Safety plan · Backup tab
We switched to Backup: build an alternate plan and emergency checklists if your first option isn’t available.
Safety plan · Checklist jumps
Use these quick chips to jump straight to People, Contacts, Places, Documents, or Grab-bag checklists.
Safety plan · Staff consultation
Request a private staff consultation ticket here to review your plan with an organization advocate.
Safety plan · Share with trusted contacts
Choose which accepted trusted contacts can view your safety plan and update or revoke access anytime.
Safety plan · Tailoring questionnaire
We opened the questionnaire popup: update circumstances here to append tailored safety checklist steps.
Notes · Pin, filter & sort records
Filter between All, Notes, and Incidents, search keywords, sort by date, and pin urgent entries to the top.
Notes · Trash & 30-day restore
Tap the Trash icon to review deleted entries and restore them within 30 days, or open any note for its edit log.
Incident editor · Date, time & map pin
We opened an Incident editor for you: record event dates, times, map/GPS locations, and encrypted evidence.
Incident editor · Upload & Olive Storage popup
We opened the attachment source sheet: capture with private camera, pick files, or link from Olive Storage.
Documents · Upload source sheet
We opened the Upload popup: upload PDFs, media, or documents AES-encrypted on your device before sync. Chat voice notes stay in chats.
Documents · Private in-app Camera
Choose Capture photo or video so evidence goes straight into encrypted storage, never to your public phone gallery.
Documents · Filters, OCR & sharing
Filter by All, Photos, Videos, or Documents; extract local OCR text on document viewers and share with accepted contacts.
Messages · DMs & Ticket chats tabs
Switch between DMs with friends and organization staff Ticket chats from these top tabs.
Messages · 48h Friend invite popup
We opened the Invite popup: share a one-time 48-hour invite code or link to connect safely with a trusted person.
Messages · Enter invite code
Paste a friend’s invite code here (or accept incoming friend requests below) to start encrypted messaging.
Messages · Support tickets & archives
We switched to Ticket chats: manage support conversations, escalate to admins, add a trusted friend, or review archived chats.
Inside chat · Voice, calls, media & Info
Inside any conversation, send chat-only voice notes, share Documents/Notes/Plans/Location, search, unsend, place encrypted calls, or tap Chat Info.
Location · Turn-by-turn GPS destination
Enter any address or coordinates or switch Driving/Walking to compute free-use turn-by-turn route guidance.
Location · Interactive map & compass
View your live coordinates, shared contact pins, heading-up compass, and expand full-screen navigation on the map.
Location · Support places directory popup
We opened the Nearby support places popup: browse mapped shelters, legal clinics, and counseling, bookmark favorites, or navigate there.
Location · Live sharing duration popup
We opened the Duration popup: choose how long selected trusted contacts can see your real-time location (stop or edit anytime).
Hotlines · Region & current location
Switch Canadian provinces or check resources near your current device location without overwriting your saved address.
Hotlines · Categories, search & favorites
Filter 24/7 crisis lines, shelters, legal aid, and counseling; heart favorites to Save, dial directly, or view on the map.
Trusted contacts · Safe directory
Add up to 25 trusted contacts, mark who is safe to stay with in an emergency, and link entries to chat friends.
My profile · Account summary cards
Review your account role, username, email consent status, cover disguise, and saved delivery/city details in one view.
Account activity · Date range filter
Pick optional local From and To dates/times to inspect suspicious sign-ins or settings edits in a specific window.
Account activity · Security audit logs
Inspect timestamped Settings edits, cover trigger unlocks, failed PIN attempts, and screen-capture privacy events.
Settings (Profile tab) · Cover & entry
Switch your cover disguise (Daily Digest or Fitness Tracker) and choose between app PIN or Android device lock.
Settings (Profile tab) · Identity & email
Update your name, affected contacts info, date of birth, email notification consent, situation notes, and city/address.
Settings (Password tab) · Account password
Rotate your Olive Branch account password cleanly after confirming your current password.
Settings (Password tab) · App PIN setup
Update your 4–6 digit app PIN or switch whether PIN is used as your primary or backup private-entry check.
Settings (Password tab) · Cover trigger
Rotate your secret cover trigger phrase while enforcing current PIN or device-lock verification.
Settings (Privacy tab) · Screen capture & emergency
Review the 2s cover olive emergency gesture and block screenshots/screen recording across Your Safe Space.
Settings (Privacy tab) · Idle auto-lock
Adjust how quickly inactivity locks Your Safe Space back to your cover (you can also extend this directly from the lock popup).
Settings (Privacy tab) · Passkey recovery
Enroll a Passkey Account Recovery Key so encrypted documents and chats can be restored cleanly on a new device.
Settings (Privacy tab) · Offline media cache
Control whether recently opened encrypted media stays cached temporarily on this device for offline access.
Settings (Permissions tab) · App updates
Check and authorize Android install permission so in-app Olive Branch security updates install smoothly.
Settings (Permissions tab) · Feature access
Review and grant camera, microphone, location, background location, notifications, calls, and Health Connect permissions.
Settings (Permissions tab) · Platform protections
Inspect system-managed network, capture detection, and background service permissions explained transparently here.
